name: Claire Dubois
role: Partner at a small seed fund, looks at about forty companies a month, writes a one-page note on each.
context: A founder in her network sent the link ahead of a call. She opens the home page and the pricing page in the car park before the meeting.
daily_tasks: Reads decks and sites quickly, compares positioning across a category, asks founders how they make money.
fears: Backing a company that cannot say what it sells or what it charges; a market so crowded that the page shows no reason to choose it.
never_reads: Feature lists, the footer, anything below the first screen unless the first screen interests her.
decides_by: A clear claim, a visible price and one reason this is different from the other tools she has seen. She decides on whether the page would convert a stranger, not on whether she would use it.
stake_rules: Bystander on almost every page: she passes by. Secondary on a pricing page, where the model of the business shows. Never primary on a product page she would not use.
